pv3:1.1: Dibbaṃ subhaṃ dhāresi vaṇṇadhātuṃ vehāyasaṃ tiṭṭhasi antalikkhe mukhañ ca te kimayo pūtigandhaṃ khādanti, kiṃ kammam akāsi pubbe ti. || ||
pv3:2.1: Samaṇo ahaṃ pāpo 'tiduṭṭhavāco tapassirūpo mukhasā asaññato laddhā ca me tapasā vaṇṇadhātu mukhañ ca me pesuṇiyena pūti. || ||
pv3:3.1: Ta-y-idaṃ tayā Nārada sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ anukampakā ye kusalā vadeyyuṃ: mā pesuṇaṃ mā ca musā abhāṇi yakkho tuvaṃ hohisi kāmakāmī ti. || ||
